data.name: Sunderborn
data.detailed_description:
You are the Creator!

You are the Creator — a Demiurge capable of creating worlds. Your task is to gather the necessary resources, transform them into building materials, and shape your own unique reality. Drawing upon the power of the World under your control, you will be able to challenge other Creators. However, before that, you must complete several intermediate steps:

• Transform the surrounding Chaos into Primordial Elements

• Summon Lesser Gods to aid you

• Forge alliances with friendly Creators

Resources

Resource gathering, also known as “Chaos Transformation,” is a logic-based puzzle. The player is faced with a vast Chaos Field, which contains hidden Primordial Elements grouped into sets of seven — called Seeds. There are six elements, divided into three pairs of antagonists:  Fire ↔ Water , Life ↔ Death and Astral ↔ Mind. Antagonistic elements can never be placed next to each other.

This rule is the core clue for solving the puzzle. The player must determine which Primordial Element is located in each position. The more accurate the player’s guesses are, the greater the reward. In addition to Primordial Elements, the player also receives Energy and various Artifacts — all of which serve as the fundamental building materials of the future World.

The Chaos Field itself changes over time. Depending on the player’s actions, these changes may either help or hinder progress. Within the field, the player may encounter Guardians, which block nearby Seeds. They must be dealt with in order to continue transforming Chaos.

Pantheon

You can summon assistants to serve you — Lesser Gods. Each of them grants the Creator a unique ability, and together they form your personal Pantheon. Lesser Gods differ in their elements, power, and relationships with one another.

Gods can create synergies with both positive and negative effects. These synergies are triggered by summoning gods from different groups at the same time — and even by their relative positions within the Pantheon. By summoning some gods, dismissing others, and rearranging their positions within the Pantheon, you customize your abilities to match your playstyle and optimize their overall impact.

Other Creators

You are not alone. Many other Creators exist alongside you, and interaction with them is a core part of the experience. These interactions are built around two main principles: free trade and exchange of any in-game items, and elemental specialization of Creators.

Trade allows players to exchange what they have in abundance for what they lack. Elemental specialization works in a similar way — if you don’t have access to something, you seek out a Creator who does. Creators aligned with certain elements are locked out of parts of the content tied to opposing elements, and gaining access to it requires cooperation with Creators of other elements.

In addition, Creators compete with one another in the Games of the Gods. These contests are not fought by the Creators themselves, but by the heroes and demigods they summon. The strength of a champion entered by a Creator depends directly on the power and balance of the World they have created.

What Comes Next?

Everything listed above is only the beginning. We plan to continue expanding the project long after launch, no matter what that launch may look like. Our future plans include:

  • A system for transforming Primordial Elements into Matter, which Creators will later use to forge their own Worlds

  • Development and management of Created Worlds through Divine Intervention and the Creators’ Avatars

  • Battles between Creators through summoned demigods and heroes

And much, much more. Most importantly — you can influence how the game evolves in the future. We are always open to interesting ideas and meaningful discussions.

data.short_description: This is a multiplayer asynchronous sandbox with elements of puzzles, logic games, world exploration, and strategy. Take on the role of the Creator, shaping your own reality out of the surrounding Chaos. Manage your created world and compete with other Gods!
data.supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.5 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 1.2 Compatible Graphics Card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.5 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 1.2 Compatible Graphics Card
